issue: Deleting a meeting room reservation was not syncing with the Room Assignments on the event. Duplicate reservations were also not being handled correctly when deleting.
notes: Built a reverse sync — deleting a reservation now automatically updates Room Assignments. Duplicate reservations are handled: deleting one keeps the room assignment until the last reservation is removed. Removing a room from Room Assignments clears all its reservations.

On Fri, May 8, 2026 at 12:56 PM Jonathan Tubay <jonathan.tubay@sentrystrategy.com> wrote:
Hi Cortney,
Hope you're doing well! We wanted to share an exciting improvement we made to the Meeting Rooms section in the portal — something we think will make managing reservations a lot smoother for your team.
What we updated with the Delete button: We reworked how the Delete button works so that deletions now stay in sync across the whole event. Here's how it behaves:
If the same room is booked more than once (for different sessions or days), deleting one reservation won't affect the others — and the room will stay in the Room Assignments at the top until the very last reservation for it is removed.
If you remove a room directly from Room Assignments at the top, it will clear all reservations for that room from the Meeting Rooms section as well.
Since your team books meeting rooms both at event creation and later through the Reserve button, we wanted to make sure everything stays in sync no matter which way you manage it.
This is already live and ready to use! Let us know if you have any questions or if anything looks off — always happy to help! 🙂

Run 2 (Youth of GEN180, started 11:13pm) went through the create-user path with a delay step, then Step 9 woke up at 11:21pm and overwrote Events with only Youth of GEN180, removing Camp 2. Zapier's Update Record step does SET not APPEND on linked fields. Manually restored Camp 2 by directly linking in Airtable. Long-term fix in progress: Code by Zapier step to fetch current Events, merge, and update via Airtable API.
fixEmail: Hi Cortney, Thank you for flagging this! We've looked into Jeremiah's access and found the root cause. When his portal account was first set up, two automated processes ran within seconds of each other — one for each of his events. The second process inadvertently overwrote the first, leaving only Youth of GEN180 linked to his account and removing Camp 2. We've already restored his access — Jeremiah should now be able to see both Youth of GEN180 and Youth of GEN180 Camp 2 when he logs in. We're also implementing a permanent fix to prevent this from happening to facilitators with multiple events in the future. It will take a bit of time to complete, but we'll keep you posted. Best, Jonathan

issue: Participant list would not upload
notes: Confirmed via Airtable that the Excel→CSV conversion succeeded every time, but zero participants were ever created. Root cause: the uploaded lists used "Legacy Lodge" in the Building column, which isn't a valid option on the Participants table's Building field (only Hotel/Lodge/Off-Site/Cabin are defined) — Airtable rejects the invalid value, and since the automation that calls jdr-service never checks for a failed response, the whole batch silently produced nothing. Fix confirmed live on a test event: changing Building to "Lodge" resolved it fully. Secondary, non-blocking issue also found: entering two phone numbers in one cell causes that specific person's phone number to be silently dropped, though the rest of their record still saves correctly.
fixEmail: Hi Cortney, Hope you are well. We found what was causing your list to not upload. Two things going forward when filling out the participant list: 1. Building column — please use the dropdown in that column and pick either Hotel or Lodge. Our system doesn't have "Legacy Lodge" as an option, so a typed-in value there that is not from the option was what stopped the whole list from going through. 2. Phone Number column — please enter just one phone number per person, in this format: (713) 301-9734. A couple rows had two numbers written in the same box, and when that happens, that person's phone number doesn't get saved. If someone gives you two numbers, just pick their main one. Thanks for your patience while we tracked this down — let us know if you run into anything else!
